items.heading: Explains the clothing of the lights in the vessels — some in the internality of the vessels, and some as surrounding lights. And it contains six matters: — 1. There are not five vessels for the five phases NaRaNChaY. 2. There are only three vessels, for Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama; and for Chaya and Yechida there are no vessels, and they became surrounding lights. 3. The three vessels of NaRaN are distinguished as external, middle, internal. 4. The direct light expands from above downward, and it is almost separated from its place in order to descend to the lower ones, and therefore it is in full Havayot, with the letters separate from one another. 5. The reflected light, which departs from Malchut and rises upward, is the secret of “Elokim” squared, whose letters rise and join one with another until they come to their root. 6. In the vessels there is front and back; but in the lights there is no front and back, only expansion and departure alone, and direct light and reflected light — because they are all internality. — There are not five vessels for the five phases NaRaNChaY
items.html: *And after all this has been explained to you in a general way, your eyes need to be enlightened so that you do not err in what was said above, and think that just as there are, in every Partzuf in every world, five phases NaRaNChaY, called internality, so too there are five phases of vessels corresponding to them — for this is not so.

items.heading: And there are only three vessels, for Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama; and for Chaya and Yechida there are no vessels, and they became surrounding lights
items.html: And the matter is that the vessels are externality and coarseness, and not all five kinds of soul could clothe in them, only the three lower ones alone, which are: Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, and for these alone there were vessels and bodies corresponding to them; 1but Chaya and Yechida of every Partzuf have no vessels corresponding to them in that Partzuf itself in which they could clothe, but they remain outside without vessels, in the secret of surrounding.

items.heading: The three vessels of NaRaN are distinguished as external, middle, internal
items.html: And thus it is found that in externality there are only three phases alone, which are three vessels — external, middle, internal — so that Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshama, which have vessels corresponding to them, may clothe within them; but Yechida and Chaya have no vessels corresponding to them in which to clothe, and they remain in the secret of surrounding light.

items.heading: The direct light expands from above downward, and it is almost separated from its place in order to descend to the lower ones, and therefore it is in full Havayot, with the letters separate from one another
items.html: *There is also another distinction, that direct light 2is almost separated from its place in order to descend and impart to the lower ones; therefore their Havayot, whether simple or full, are all Havayot with letters separate from one another.

items.heading: The reflected light, which departs from Malchut and rises upward, is the secret of “Elokim” squared, whose letters rise and join one with another until they come to their root
items.html: Indeed, 3reflected light is a square such as this: Aleph, Alef-Lamed, Alef-Lamed-Heh, Alef-Lamed-Heh-Yod, Alef-Lamed-Heh-Yod-Mem [Elokim], where the letters are always joined, to indicate that they are rising, and are joined one to another until they join with their root and their Emanator, for their will is to depart from the lower ones.

items.heading: In the vessels there is front and back. But in the lights there is no front and back. Only expansion and departure alone, and direct light and reflected light. Because they are all internality
items.html: *Now one needs to understand very well the truth of the matter of front and back: for in the lights, they are called expansion and departure, and are called direct and reflected. But in the vessels, they are called front and back. That is to say, in the light front and back do not apply, for it is all internality.
